# Google Arts & Culture

> > A comprehensive digital platform providing access to 2000+ museums and cultural institutions worldwide with virtual tours, interactive experiments, and curated exhibitions of global artistic heritage.

Google Arts & Culture democratizes access to world-class museums and artwork through virtual tours, high-resolution imagery, and AI-powered interactive experiences. The platform partners with major institutions globally to preserve and showcase cultural heritage from Renaissance masterpieces to contemporary art.

## Key Topics

- Virtual tours
- Museum collections
- Renaissance art
- Art history
- Cultural heritage
- Interactive exhibits
- Artwork discovery
- Global museums
- Historical artists
- Art Camera
- Street View
- Curated exhibitions
- Museum partnerships
- Artwork locations
- AI experiments

## Core Exploration

- [Google Arts & Culture](https://artsandculture.google.com): Homepage featuring 2000+ museums and archives with virtual tours and artwork discovery
- [Explore](https://artsandculture.google.com/explore): Main exploration interface with Art Camera, Street View, and thematic exhibit browsing
- [Collections](https://artsandculture.google.com/partner): Directory of 2000+ partnered museums including Musée d'Orsay and National Gallery of Art

## Interactive Experiences

- [Play with Google Arts & Culture](https://artsandculture.google.com/play): Interactive games and AI-powered art experiments for cultural learning and exploration
- [Learn Everything](https://artsandculture.google.com/experiment/learn-everything/qwGvFCEHA4HpQQ): AI experiment turning images into personalized educational explanations on any subject
- [Yinka Ilori's Dreaming with Flamingos](https://artsandculture.google.com/experiment/yinka-ilori-s-dreaming-with-flamingos/igEHyUTKayb9Lw): Interactive AI-powered musical playground by artist Yinka Ilori exploring Nigerian heritage

## Curated Exhibitions & Themes

- [Themes](https://artsandculture.google.com/project): Curated virtual exhibitions and thematic projects exploring global cultural heritage
- [The National Gallery: Reframed](https://artsandculture.google.com/project/the-national-gallery): Interactive exhibition of National Gallery London with virtual tours and art history

## Artist Guides & Collections

- [Where to Catch Gustav Klimt Around the World](https://artsandculture.google.com/story/zgXRNmkGIQVG1A): Guide to Gustav Klimt's works across global museums and Vienna's modernist art scene
- [Where to Catch Leonardo Around the World](https://artsandculture.google.com/story/gAWhkLO_CaaEvQ): Museum guide to Leonardo da Vinci's Renaissance masterpieces worldwide beyond Italy
- [Where to Catch Michelangelo Around the World](https://artsandculture.google.com/story/4gWBIKhrAFHxtA): Museum locations of Michelangelo's Renaissance masterpieces beyond Florence and Italy
- [Where to Catch Rembrandt Around the World](https://artsandculture.google.com/story/egXRpK1pj68VmA): Guide to Rembrandt's Dutch masterworks in museums worldwide including Rijksmuseum
- [Where to See Artemisia Gentileschi Around the World](https://artsandculture.google.com/story/cQUBA_bXbGJt7g): Locations of Artemisia Gentileschi's baroque works in global museums and collections

## Conservation & Analysis

- [A New Light on Van Gogh's Irises](https://artsandculture.google.com/story/zgXRNmkGIQVG1A): Van Gogh's Irises examined through conservation science and color analysis at Getty Museum
